parole.testo: Borrowed from North Caucasian languages, specifically West Circassian абрэгь (abrɛgʲ) (standart Adyghe абрэдж (abrɛdž)). The term is widely distributed across the Caucasus; compare Ossetian абырӕг (abyræg), Chechen обург (oburg), Georgian აბრაგი (abragi). Compare Armenian ավազակ (avazak, “robber”).
